_comment: LANDING PREDICATES — the single source of truth for what DONE means, per card_type.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Measured 2026-08-31: of 31 pull requests the AA conveyor has ever
produced, 28 backed a card that reached DONE and exactly 2 had ever merged — both merged by
a human, more than two months earlier. DONE meant 'an action call returned ok', which for a
code deliverable means 'a PR was opened': activity-action.json :: Dispatch Card Lifecycle
computes ok = !!pr_url under success_when 'pr_opened', and qa-evaluate :: Resolve Target List
routes to DONE on the verdict that follows. The work was marked complete on evidence that it
was PROPOSED. It then never landed, was re-detected, and was issued again — the seeded
aa_bugfix_probe bug produced five byte-identical PRs (#94, #113, #117, #118, #119) whose five
cards all sat in DONE.
THE INVARIANT THIS FILE ENCODES: a card is in DONE iff its deliverable has been OBSERVED to
land in the world. 'Landed' differs per deliverable class, and each class names an observer.
Nothing here is satisfied by a call that returned 200.
⚠️ CORRECTED — the two fixtures this used to cite NO LONGER EXIST. The text read: 'pr_opened
IS NOT A LOOPHOLE — IT IS A REQUIRED EXEMPTION. This repository drives two harness fixtures
whose READMEs mandate that their PR must NOT be merged: aa_bugfix_probe … and
aa_feature_probe … That is what repo_policy below is for.' All five aa_*_probe/ directories
were deleted from nonagenticai/enterprise_mcp_server (its PR #147): seeding a PUBLIC repo
with deliberately vulnerable code as a test fixture was a mistake. So repo_policy is now
EMPTY and pr_opened is currently UNREACHABLE — nothing degrades. The predicate and the
mechanism are kept because the ARGUMENT still holds for any future must-not-merge fixture:
merging one consumes the seed, and a registry that could not express 'the proposal IS the
deliverable' would break such a fixture on its first tick. See repo_policy._comment.
⚠️ UNKNOWN card_type FAILS OPEN, deliberately. A card_type absent from this map gets 'none'
and is never held out of DONE. Blocking on a type we failed to read would be the prefetch sin
inverted: suppressing work on the strength of a field we could not parse. The sweeper counts
unknown types in its report so the gap is visible rather than silent.

pr_merged.means: a pull request the card produced has been merged
pr_merged.gate: qa-evaluate :: Resolve Target List holds the card in BLOCKED with block_reason awaiting_merge
pr_merged.drain: none since 2026-09-27 (AA Maintenance - Delivery Sweep RETIRED, vision WP-D: no clock-pushed work); CI/PR-event delivery replaces it

pr_opened.means: the proposal itself is the deliverable; the PR must NOT be merged
pr_opened.observer: a non-empty pr_url on the card
pr_opened.gate: none — the card reaches DONE as today

asset_promoted.means: a DONE-phase promote cell swapped the candidate onto the base

asset_persisted.means: the card's asset_id field is bound to an element that was READ BACK from its owning service
asset_persisted.observer: a kind:'asset' entry with a non-empty id in evidence.deliverables. doing-orchestrate :: Build Persist Input emits it ONLY from a successful step output shaped {element_id, bound:true} — the return value of the doing.action's assert_element_persisted compute step, which throws unless getArchitectureElement returned the same id with a non-empty body AND bind_element_to_card (customFieldValue.set on asset_id) succeeded
asset_persisted.gate: qa-evaluate :: Apply Exit Rule holds the card in BLOCKED with blocking_gate asset_not_persisted; no entry (including an absent deliverables field) is NOT landed
asset_persisted.drain: none since 2026-09-27 (AA Maintenance - Blocked Sweep RETIRED, vision WP-D: no clock-pushed work); the pull mechanism re-queues the card

hunt_commit_landed.means: a hunt-mode development_bug_fix card's fix was committed to its hunt branch aa/bughunt-<H>; the merge belongs to the parent bug_hunt_sweep H, whose own QA-cell machine (B15) compares that branch (f5) and opens the ONE hunt PR
hunt_commit_landed.observer: a kind:'hunt_commit' deliverable (id '<fix_branch>@<40-hex sha>') in evidence.deliverables, emitted by doing-orchestrate :: Build Persist Input ONLY for a card whose card_inputs.hunt_mode === true, from the step output {hunt_commit, commit_sha} of the hunt variant's assert step
hunt_commit_landed.gate: none — landing is deferred to the parent hunt card (G1 design §3.5 V4-1); any kind:'pr' deliverable on the same run voids the override and the pr_merged hold applies unchanged

none.means: no externally observable landing artifact; DONE is decided by the QA verdict alone

_promote_gate_is_stamp_only: asset_promoted RECORDS but does not BLOCK, and that is a measured decision, not caution.
Census 2026-08-31, positive control stated first: execution_entity holds ZERO rows for all
four promote workflows (5zK4QXfO5cjyIduv workflow, yeN0MwnLi3WtlJ0t procedure,
S7JzJ8xwJxvM8UO8 prompt, cjl1nMKvuUPXKoWy asset) across the entire retained history — 63,727
executions spanning 2026-08-24..08-31. Retention is ~7 days, so there is no 30-day window to
ask about. The improvement loops have not promoted anything at all, so 'how many cards would
a gate move, and how many wrongly' is unmeasurable; today's honest answer is 0 and 0.
And the reason strings cannot carry a gate even once data exists. They are not separable:
INTENDED  'base update failed (base may be a read-only inherited system-tenant procedure)'
— correct fail-safe behaviour; blocking would move a CORRECT card out of DONE.
MIXED     asset-promote 'base fetch failed' bundles a transient 5xx with a read-only 404;
prompt-promote 'prompt swap failed (base missing, CAS mismatch, or 422)' bundles
an intended 404 with two real defects. The reader cannot tell them apart.
SILENT    workflow-promote on a failed workflow.update emits promoted:false with
skip_reason null — indistinguishable from success except by the boolean.
Blocking therefore has two named prerequisites, and they are real work, not a formality:
1. split the MIXED strings into distinct machine-readable codes in the four promote cells;
2. give workflow-promote a reason on its failed-update path.
Until both land, this predicate writes promote_landed / promote_skip_reason to the card and
leaves the card where the QA verdict put it.
_card_types_provenance: The eight pr_merged types are exactly the card types MEASURED to carry a real pr_url on the
live board (kanban DB, 2026-08-31): development_chore 14, development_bug_fix 5,
development_poc / development_feature_update / development_feature_new 1 each in DONE, plus
dependency_refactoring and the two security-patch types on cards in BLOCKED. They are not a
guess at which types 'sound like' code.
⚠️ verification_test is 'none' ON PURPOSE even though done-finalize's PUBLISH_PR_ON_DONE set
contains it. That set makes a verification_test card MARK THE CHAIN'S PR READY; the card does
not carry a pr_url of its own (measured: 8 in DONE, 0 with a pr_url). The card that carries
the PR is the development_* card upstream of it, and that is where the predicate belongs.
Putting pr_merged here would hold a card hostage to an artifact it does not own.
⛔ RE-MEASURED 2026-09-02 — THE TABLE WAS INCOMPLETE AND IT WAS LEAKING. architecture_refactoring
(6 cards carrying a real pr_url, 2 of them ALREADY IN DONE) and decoupling_refactoring (1) do
produce pull requests and were absent, so landingPredicateFor() returned 'none' and they reached
DONE on unmerged PRs. Three did so on 2026-09-01 alone — PRs #129/#130/#131, all still OPEN, all
three cards in DONE — AFTER the gate was armed. Both types are added above as pr_merged.
⚠️ A TABLE OF MEASURED TYPES CANNOT STOP THE NEXT ONE. Adding two strings closes today's instance
and leaves the mechanism — an unknown type fails OPEN — exactly as it was. That is why the
generator's fallback now ALSO consults the run's evidence (a kind:'pr' deliverable): this table
stays the readable authority, and the evidence is the backstop for the type nobody has enumerated
yet. Both are needed; neither alone is sufficient.
⛔ ADDED 2026-09-21 — architecture_task -> asset_persisted. architecture_task is ~51% of the
cards on the conveyor board and was ABSENT here, so it failed open: a card reached DONE having
produced nothing. Its doing.action (AA_IMPLEMENTATION/doing_action_procedures.json) authors an
architecture element (requirements service, architecture_elements table), reads it back, and
binds its id to the card's asset_id custom field; the terminal compute step
assert_element_persisted returns {element_id, bound:true} only when all three held. That
return value is the observation. It reaches QA as a kind:'asset' deliverable (element_id is
not in the generic harvest's _ID_KEYS, so Build Persist Input recognises the {element_id,
bound:true} shape explicitly and hoists it past the 460-char trim). It is NOT pr_merged —
architecture_task has 0 cards that ever carried a pr_url (see M11 in the fragment) — and it
is deliberately scoped to architecture_task only: the seven sibling element-authoring types
(architecture_epic, architecture_subtask, design_packaging, domain_analysis,
future_state_analysis, narrative_design, plateau_planning_analysis) share the same tail but
were not measured here, and a table entry is how they opt in.
2026-09-24 IT findings grid G5: code_smell_refactoring -> pr_merged. Lint/complexity fixes land
as PR commits like development_bug_fix: its doing.action (AA_IMPLEMENTATION/
doing_action_procedures.json) ends applyCodeChanges -> createPullRequest -> validatePullRequest,
so absent from this table it failed open and could reach DONE on an unmerged PR.

_comment: Per-card_type override keyed on the run's EVIDENCE (evidence.deliverables, entries {kind, id}),
NOT on card_inputs: qa-evaluate :: Apply Exit Rule never sees card_inputs, and step outputs reach
it stripped; the deliverables channel is what survives (G1 back-half design §3.5, V4-1).
Rule (generated into <landing-core> :: landingPredicateFor, so qa-evaluate and done-finalize
cannot disagree): for a card_type listed here, if the run carries NO kind:'pr' deliverable and
carries a deliverable whose kind is listed, the predicate is the listed one. Any PR evidence
leaves the card_types predicate (pr_merged) in force — a hunt card that somehow opened a PR is
held like every other PR-bearing card. Only hunt-mode dispatch emits kind:'hunt_commit'.
Pinned by scripts/tests/test-landing-predicates.mjs and scripts/tests/test-dbf-hunt.mjs (A19).
Per-repository override, applied to a card whose predicate is pr_merged. The key is
'<owner>/<repo>' exactly as it appears in the card's pr_repo_owner / pr_repo_name fields.
A path prefix under paths_pr_opened means: if EVERY file the PR touches sits under one of
these prefixes, the card's predicate degrades to pr_opened. Scoped by PATH rather than by
repo, so a repo that is BOTH a real product and the host of a fixture keeps its genuine
work gated.
⛔ THE MAP IS EMPTY, AND THAT IS THE CURRENT TRUTH — DO NOT RE-ADD AN ENTRY TO MAKE A GATE
GO QUIET. It held exactly one key, 'nonagenticai/enterprise_mcp_server', naming the three
harness-fixture directories aa_bugfix_probe/ aa_feature_probe/ aa_refactor_probe/. Those
directories were DELETED from that repository (enterprise_mcp_server PR #147) because
committing deliberately vulnerable code to a public repo as a test fixture was a mistake.
Once the paths are gone no PR can match a prefix, so the entry could only ever have
degraded nothing — dead config naming deleted directories. With the map empty,
prLandingPolicy() returns 'pr_merged' for every repo (the !cfg branch), i.e. an ems PR that
touches only those former-fixture paths now requires a MERGE to count as landed. Intended.
The MECHANISM stays: a future fixture with a real must-not-merge README gets a key here.
Pinned by scripts/tests/test-landing-predicates.mjs § 4, which fails if the entry returns.
